_what_this_is: Every number this repository publishes that is derived from MORE THAN ONE
capture, with the derivation written out so a machine can redo it.
python3 harness/check_claims.py       re-derives every claimed value
python3 harness/check_claims.py --show  prints what each one derives to
harness/fields.py --check already guards the numbers a document quotes
from the capture named beside it. That binds one claim to ONE capture,
which is the right shape for 'the measurement record is 528 bytes' and the
wrong shape for a ratio, which has two captures and belongs to neither.
This file owns exactly that gap and nothing else.
A value of null is not a placeholder. It means the quantity is named, the
derivation is written, and the answer is not known — normally because a
tool cannot reach it yet. The reason is in the claim.
Every tolerance_pct is 0.0. These are bytes and round trips re-derived from
captures that are committed here, so there is nothing for a tolerance to
absorb: the same file gives the same answer or the file changed. A non-zero
tolerance on a deterministic quantity is a check that has been asked not to
fail. The day something timing-related is published, it will arrive with a
median, a p95 and a stated number of runs instead of a tolerance.
★ A term may be a `const` instead of a capture reading, and that is how a
measurement gets compared with a number from OUTSIDE this repository — a
signature length in FIPS 204, or a message's fixed part counted out of
DSP0274's field layout. The two shapes are deliberately different so a
reader can see which half of a comparison came off the wire.

pqc_certchain_ratio_mldsa65_vs_ecdsa384.meaning: responder slot 0 certificate chain, ML-DSA-65 over ECDSA-P384, same build and the same DMTF sample chain layout
pqc_certchain_ratio_mldsa65_vs_ecdsa384.note: ★ read from the CAPTURE by both terms now. Until 2026-09-14 the numerator had to come through spdm_dump's decode, because the post-quantum chain arrives inside CHUNK_RESPONSE and pcapstat's chain walk read CERTIFICATE. pcapstat reassembles the chunk sequence as of that date, so this ratio no longer depends on a decoder whose own output is truncated

pqc_chain_reassembly_agrees_with_windowe.meaning: ★ the SAME chain by two routes through the SAME tool: reassembled out of a chunk sequence in P2-all, and walked out of plain CERTIFICATE messages in P2-nochunk, where removing the responder's CHUNK_CAP made libspdm fetch it in DataTransferSize-sized windows instead. Zero is the assertion

pqc_handshake_ratio_level3_meas_op_all.meaning: total captured bytes at matched NIST category 3, ML-DSA-65+ML-KEM-768 over ECDSA-P384+ECDHE-P384, with --meas_op ALL: one GET_MEASUREMENTS, one signed response

pqc_handshake_ratio_level3_meas_op_one_b.meaning: ★ the same ratio over the emulator's DEFAULT measurement flow, which walks every measurement index. It is a different number, and publishing either one without naming the flow is what makes a cost table unfalsifiable

pqc_handshake_ratio_level5_meas_op_all.meaning: ★★ the SECOND matched comparison, at NIST category 5: ML-DSA-87+ML-KEM-1024 over ECDSA-P521+ECDHE-P521. 10.91x against 8.99x at category 3 is what two algorithm groups could not show — the gap is a function of the security level, not one number

pqc_handshake_ratio_level5_meas_op_one_b.meaning: and the same flow dilution at category 5: 7.55x against 10.91x. Both directions of conditionality, on both comparisons

signature_bytes_ecdsa_p384_from_the_wire.meaning: ★ CHALLENGE_AUTH carries exactly one signature and 142 bytes of content fixed by the negotiated hash: 4 header + 48 chain hash + 32 nonce + 48 summary hash + 2 opaque length + 8 opaque data. Subtract it and what is left is the signature. 96 is ECDSA P-384's r||s, and NOTHING in this pipeline was told that

signature_bytes_ecdsa_p521_from_the_wire.meaning: the same subtraction on the P-521 arm. 132 is 2 x 66, SEC 1's r||s at that curve

signature_bytes_ml_dsa_44_from_the_wire.meaning: FIPS 204's ML-DSA-44 signature length, reproduced from a message-size difference

signature_bytes_ml_dsa_65_from_the_wire.meaning: ★ FIPS 204's ML-DSA-65 signature length, 3309, reproduced from a message-size difference. This is the strongest single number in Table 2: six residuals landing on six published constants is not something a miscalibrated tool does, and it is what says the 142 is constant across the arms rather than assumed to be

signature_bytes_ml_dsa_87_from_the_wire.meaning: FIPS 204's ML-DSA-87 signature length. ★ Note where it comes from: at ML-DSA-87 the CHALLENGE_AUTH itself exceeds the 4,608-byte DataTransferSize, so there is no single CHALLENGE_AUTH message on the wire to measure. logical_by_type is the de-chunked view, and this arm is the reason it exists

signature_bytes_slh_dsa_sha2_128s_from_t.meaning: ★ FIPS 205's SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s signature length, reassembled from the two chunks its CHALLENGE_AUTH arrived in. It matters because this arm's handshake does NOT complete: the responder signed correctly and at the right length, and the requester still exited 1, which is what narrows the failure to signature verification

vca_bytes_spread_across_all_six_groups.meaning: ★★ max minus min of the Version-Capabilities-Algorithms-only captures over all six algorithm groups. Zero means the negotiation is byte-identical whether it selects ECDSA P-384 or SLH-DSA — so not one byte of post-quantum cost is paid to AGREE on the algorithm. Written as a spread rather than five pairwise deltas so that a seventh group strengthens it for free

vca_bytes_standalone_matches_the_subtota.meaning: ★ two routes to the negotiation's cost. A whole capture that does nothing but negotiate holds 152 SPDM bytes; the same six message types inside the FULL post-quantum capture add up to the same 152. So the subtotal is trustworthy without the standalone arm, and the standalone arm is what says so

cert_roundtrips_mldsa65.meaning: how many times the requester asked for a certificate chain in the post-quantum arm. A round trip is a latency cost a byte count does not show

cert_roundtrips_ecdsa384.meaning: the same count in the classical arm. Equal, so at THIS DataTransferSize the post-quantum chain cost bytes and not certificate-layer round trips — it cost them at the chunking layer instead, which is a claim about the transport rather than about the algorithm

pqc_chunk_roundtrips_mldsa65.meaning: ★ the round trips the chain actually cost, which are NOT GET_CERTIFICATE: the chain exceeds the negotiated DataTransferSize, so SPDM's chunking layer carries it and each chunk is a complete request/response exchange. The classical arm has none

max_spdm_msg_size_advertised_by_the_clas.meaning: ★★ the platform-layer finding, read off the wire in the arm that negotiates ECDSA P-384. 163840 is 0x28000, and spdm_emu.h picks it ONLY because SLH-DSA is compiled in — ML-DSA-only would give 0x8000 and neither would give 0x1200. So the buffer requirement an endpoint advertises is set by the worst algorithm its firmware CAN do, not the one it negotiated, and it is announced before any algorithm is chosen. On a root of trust with 256 KB of SRAM that is a BOM decision made by a #define

dts_patch_is_inert_at_the_default_value.meaning: ★★ the control that makes the DataTransferSize sweep admissible. The patched build (pqc-dts: larger buffers plus transport/data-transfer-size.patch) told to advertise 4608 — the value the UNPATCHED build computes — must reproduce the unpatched build's capture. Zero difference in captured bytes is that assertion. A diff cannot establish this; only a capture can. ADR 0009

dts_patch_is_inert_in_round_trips_too.meaning: the same control on the quantity the sweep is about, because two captures can have equal byte totals and different message counts

dts_sweep_byte_spread_fraction.meaning: ★ captured bytes at the smallest DataTransferSize over the largest, across a 32x range of the parameter. 1.031 — a 3.1% spread — is the half of the finding that says DataTransferSize is NOT a bandwidth knob

dts_sweep_chunk_roundtrips_at_the_smalle.meaning: ★ and the other half. Same 32x range, same two captures as the claim above: round trips go from 59 to 0 while the bytes move 3.1%. Each one is a bus RTT

removing_chunk_cap_cost_fewer_bytes_not_.meaning: ★ P2 with the responder's CHUNK_CAP removed, minus P2 with it. NEGATIVE: turning chunking off made the post-quantum handshake nine bytes smaller and three round trips shorter, because libspdm then windows GET_CERTIFICATE to DataTransferSize instead of asking for the whole chain, being refused with ERROR(LargeResponse) three times, and chunking. A statement about libspdm's requester policy, not about DSP0274

removing_chunk_cap_cost_fewer_packets.meaning: the same arm pair in packets: 40 against 46, which is three fewer request/response exchanges. Twelve windowed certificate fetches replace three refusals plus twelve chunk round trips

mldsa_knee_point_44_to_65_is_cheaper_tha.meaning: ★ the reason this project recommends ML-DSA-65 rather than repeating a default: 44→65 costs +15,629 captured bytes and 65→87 costs +20,576, so 65 is where the curve bends. Stated as a null because the quantity a machine should assert is a DIFFERENCE OF DIFFERENCES, and check_claims.py has no kind for that. The two increments are each derivable from the captures named here, and docs/pqc-cost.md §13 shows the arithmetic; a `second_difference` kind is week 10's if a second such claim appears

tamper_detect_rate.meaning: of the capture arms that rats/out/expected.json says MUST be rejected, the fraction the committed verdicts reject. Anything but 1.0 is the assertion this repository exists to make, failing

mctp_packet_ratio_level3_meas_op_all.meaning: ★ MCTP PACKETS, counted off a real link, ML-DSA-65+ML-KEM-768 over ECDSA-P384+ECDHE-P384 at matched NIST category 3. The byte ratio for the same pair is 8.99; this is smaller because a transmission unit is charged whole and the classical arm has more short messages
mctp_packet_ratio_level3_meas_op_all.note: the denominator and numerator are different captures of different arms, which is why this lives here and not in a fields.py claim comment

mctp_transport_changed_nothing_a0.meaning: ★ THE CONTROL. The classical handshake carried across a real MCTP link, recorded at the SPDM message layer, against the same handshake carried over spdm-emu's TCP socket in week eight. Zero is the assertion: the transport changed nothing about the protocol, so any difference in the packet layer is the transport and not the handshake

mctp_transport_changed_nothing_p2.meaning: the same control for the post-quantum arm, where there is far more to go wrong: 46 messages, four chunking round trips and a 16,853-byte chain, reassembled by the kernel out of 264 packets and arriving byte-count identical to the socket line

mctp_model_reproduces_every_observed_pac.meaning: ★ the number of messages in the post-quantum link capture whose observed packet count the model did NOT reproduce. Zero over 46 messages and 953 packets. Written as a count of failures rather than of successes so that an empty capture cannot pass it

mctp_calibration_messages_that_separate_.meaning: ★ how many of the calibration replay's messages are lengths at which the subtract-the-header formula gives a DIFFERENT answer from the model. This is the claim that the calibration discriminates rather than merely agreeing: until 2026-09-18 this project named 177 bytes as the separating case, and 59 x 3 = 177, so it separated nothing
